a fragment with no transmitter before the Companion: «قال أبو مسعود أنا قد، سمعت هذا، من رسول الله» is read as a single-link route (rule 10); the saying itself is not in the text
The text has no transmission verb: Abu Mas'ud speaks and says he heard this from the Messenger, so he is the single link (rule 10). No chain is written before him.
